mapper.select: SELECT t1.* FROM hls_doc_layout_screen t1 WHERE t1.layout_code = #{layout_code} AND t1.tab_code = #{tab_code} AND t1.column_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t1.order_seq DESC
SELECT nvl(t.COLUMN_COUNT, 1) columnCount, nvl(t.ROW_COUNT, 1) rowCount FROM hls_doc_layout_tab t WHERE t.LAYOUT_CODE = #{layout_code} AND t.TAB_CODE = #{tab_code}
